name: agentltl
description: AgentLTL rules in front of every Codex tool call, shell commands included: never, before, after, at most, finally.

interface.shortDescription: Enforce rules on every tool call
interface.longDescription: Write rules in AGENTLTL.yaml (never force-push, read a file before overwriting it, run the tests before finishing...). Every Codex tool call, shell commands and apply_patch included, is checked against them before it runs.
